correctness.rationale: For a uniform BST root split, independent subtrees give the exact additive leaf and path recursions; the sole deviations from a constant leaf conditional expectation occur at subtrees of size 0 and 1. With known and independently derived first moments this produces the exact conditional-mean covariance -4(H_{n-1}-1)/(3n). The law of total covariance telescopes to -(n+3)(n-2)/(9n). The stand-alone exact verifier checks 100 moment recursions and 46,233 exhaustive permutations of sizes 1..8. Finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Leaf number captures the frequency of terminal subproblems while total internal path length equals the number of Quicksort comparisons under the standard coupling. The sharp finite-n negative dependence and linear growth, generated entirely by four exceptional root splits even though the conditional leaf mean is flat at every interior split, reveal a structural mechanism rather than a generic covariance computation or arbitrary finite cutoff.
